signal: Trackforce/TrackTik shipped new Q1 2026 capabilities including The Evidence Layer and role-specific Job-Based Views, plus a cyber-physical convergence report.

email.body1:
Vincent, saw Trackforce shipped new capabilities this year like the Evidence Layer and role-based views across the TrackTik platform.

New capabilities usually open more enterprise accounts than the team can touch before reps ramp on the message, and that is where pipeline cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for your enterprise accounts off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Vincent, quick follow-up on the enterprise side.

With a stronger product story to sell, the target list usually outruns the team's capacity to work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise motion needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Vincent, last bit of proof for your Trackforce team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer enterprise software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Vincent, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters and I know the quarter is busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Trackforce either way.
